text:
**Three of the 25 obligor groups with an approved limit are over it once every controlled subsidiary is rolled up (as of 30 Sep 2026):**

| Obligor group (ultimate parent) | Loan commitments | Capital-markets exposure | **Group exposure** | Approved limit | Utilization | Over by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Brightwater Group Inc (LE-10030) | $236.6M (21 facilities, 13 borrowers) | $0.0M | **$236.6M** | $200.0M | **118.3%** | **$36.6M** |
| Halvorsen Industrial Group Inc (LE-10001) | $308.0M (10 facilities) | $36.3M | **$344.3M** | $300.0M | **114.8%** | **$44.3M** |
| Corvane Partners Inc (LE-10052) | $171.2M (16 facilities, 11 borrowers) | $0.0M | **$171.2M** | $150.0M | **114.1%** | **$21.2M** |

- **Why rolling up matters:** no single borrower in Brightwater or Corvane is anywhere near its group's limit. The largest borrowers in each have only $25.8M and $27.4M committed. The breaches only show up when the ownership tree is summed.
- **Approval:** under the bank's lending-authority rule, any credit action on a group above its limit goes to the **Senior Credit Committee**.
- **Legal lending limit ($360M per group):** none of the three is over it. Halvorsen is at 95.6%, leaving $15.7M of room. It was also just downgraded to CCC+, which maps to internal rating 8 (Substandard), and its facilities are waiting to be re-rated (from an earlier saved answer).
- **Partly owned companies left out:** each group has one minority stake the parent doesn't control, so it isn't counted. Brightwater Distribution LLC is 23% owned and Corvane Properties Co is 46% owned. Neither has active loan facilities with us. I did not check them for capital-markets exposure.
- **Facilities rated 7 (Special Mention) inside the over-limit groups:** at least one facility at Brightwater Distribution Inc (CIF 41034), Corvane Energy Inc (41072) and Corvane Foods Inc (41064). Expect these to come up in the committee papers.

**Close to the limit but not over:** Stellmark Group 91.5% ($164.7M of $180M) and Ridgeport Group 90.1% ($108.1M of $120M). After those come Marrowind 82.9%, Valewood 81.1% and Oakhurst 80.3%. The other 15 groups are below 80%.

**Sources and definitions**
- **Group membership:** the knowledge layer's governed list of obligor groups. Each group is the ultimate parent plus every entity it currently controls at any depth (rule BR-CUST-01). I checked the ownership table (`RISK_DEMO.dbo.OWNERSHIP`) for Brightwater and Corvane to confirm which entities are excluded.
  - The group-tracing tool returned an error, so I used the governed list directly. The old hierarchy table (`CPTY_HIER_LEGACY`) is deprecated and I didn't use it.
- **Group exposure (rule BR-EXP-01, ratified):**
  - Committed amounts of ACTIVE facilities from `BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY`.
  - Plus capital-markets current exposure (the positive part of mark-to-market) at the latest snapshot, 30 Sep 2026, from `RISK_DEMO.dbo.CM_EXPOSURE`.
  - Notional and drawn amounts are not counted.
- **Limits:** the approved group limit from `RISK_DEMO.dbo.CREDIT_LIMIT`, which has one limit per ultimate parent. Utilization = exposure / limit, and anything above 1.0 is over limit.
- **Rules used:** BR-LLL-01 (legal lending limit of $360M, 15% of $2.40B capital and surplus) and BR-DLA-01 (who approves credit actions).
- **Assumptions:**
  - I didn't net guarantees. Under BR-GUAR-01 only active guarantees from outside the group would reduce exposure.
  - Only groups with an approved limit are covered.

                 MERGE (d)-[:ABOUT]->(n) RETURN collect(DISTINCT n.id) AS about

MATCH (d:DecisionTrace {id: $id}) UNWIND $checks AS c
                   MATCH (p:Policy {id: c.policy})
                   MERGE (d)-[r:CHECKED]->(p) SET r.decision = c.decision RETURN collect(p.id + ':' + c.decision) AS checked

question: Which obligor groups are over their approved credit limit once all their subsidiaries are rolled up?
answer:
**Three of the 25 obligor groups with an approved limit are over it once every controlled subsidiary is rolled up (as of 30 Sep 2026):**

| Obligor group (ultimate parent) | Loan commitments | Capital-markets exposure | **Group exposure** | Approved limit | Utilization | Over by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Brightwater Group Inc (LE-10030) | $236.6M (21 facilities, 13 borrowers) | $0.0M | **$236.6M** | $200.0M | **118.3%** | **$36.6M** |
| Halvorsen Industrial Group Inc (LE-10001) | $308.0M (10 facilities) | $36.3M | **$344.3M** | $300.0M | **114.8%** | **$44.3M** |
| Corvane Partners Inc (LE-10052) | $171.2M (16 facilities, 11 borrowers) | $0.0M | **$171.2M** | $150.0M | **114.1%** | **$21.2M** |

- **Why rolling up matters:** no single borrower in Brightwater or Corvane is anywhere near its group's limit. The largest borrowers in each have only $25.8M and $27.4M committed. The breaches only show up when the ownership tree is summed.
- **Approval:** under the bank's lending-authority rule, any credit action on a group above its limit goes to the **Senior Credit Committee**.
- **Legal lending limit ($360M per group):** none of the three is over it. Halvorsen is at 95.6%, leaving $15.7M of room. It was also just downgraded to CCC+, which maps to internal rating 8 (Substandard), and its facilities are waiting to be re-rated (from an earlier saved answer).
- **Partly owned companies left out:** each group has one minority stake the parent doesn't control, so it isn't counted. Brightwater Distribution LLC is 23% owned and Corvane Properties Co is 46% owned. Neither has active loan facilities with us. I did not check them for capital-markets exposure.
- **Facilities rated 7 (Special Mention) inside the over-limit groups:** at least one facility at Brightwater Distribution Inc (CIF 41034), Corvane Energy Inc (41072) and Corvane Foods Inc (41064). Expect these to come up in the committee papers.

**Close to the limit but not over:** Stellmark Group 91.5% ($164.7M of $180M) and Ridgeport Group 90.1% ($108.1M of $120M). After those come Marrowind 82.9%, Valewood 81.1% and Oakhurst 80.3%. The other 15 groups are below 80%.

**Sources and definitions**
- **Group membership:** the knowledge layer's governed list of obligor groups. Each group is the ultimate parent plus every entity it currently controls at any depth (rule BR-CUST-01). I checked the ownership table (`RISK_DEMO.dbo.OWNERSHIP`) for Brightwater and Corvane to confirm which entities are excluded.
  - The group-tracing tool returned an error, so I used the governed list directly. The old hierarchy table (`CPTY_HIER_LEGACY`) is deprecated and I didn't use it.
- **Group exposure (rule BR-EXP-01, ratified):**
  - Committed amounts of ACTIVE facilities from `BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY`.
  - Plus capital-markets current exposure (the positive part of mark-to-market) at the latest snapshot, 30 Sep 2026, from `RISK_DEMO.dbo.CM_EXPOSURE`.
  - Notional and drawn amounts are not counted.
- **Limits:** the approved group limit from `RISK_DEMO.dbo.CREDIT_LIMIT`, which has one limit per ultimate parent. Utilization = exposure / limit, and anything above 1.0 is over limit.
- **Rules used:** BR-LLL-01 (legal lending limit of $360M, 15% of $2.40B capital and surplus) and BR-DLA-01 (who approves credit actions).
- **Assumptions:**
  - I didn't net guarantees. Under BR-GUAR-01 only active guarantees from outside the group would reduce exposure.
  - Only groups with an approved limit are covered.
